adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code fetches a new access token (lines 72-87), parses it (line 89), validates it (lines 91-93), and persists it to the database (lines 95-98). However, the jsforce.Connection is then initialized using the original `credentialKey` object (lines 100-108), not the newly refreshed `accessTokenParsed.data`. This means the connection will use the stale/expired token from `credentialKey` rather than the freshly obtained token, causing authentication failures on subsequent API calls.
